policy: Project Direction is the canonical strategic state for serious Factory projects. UI Hub cards render this record; card strategy is never maintained as separate hard-coded text.

stewardship.ownerDecisionRole: Material pivots, spending, launch/publication, and kill/revive decisions
stewardship.maintenanceRule: Update canonical project state once; UI Hub reflects it. Do not maintain a second card-specific strategy record.

migration.rule: Migrate serious active projects first. Unmigrated UI assets remain valid but the Hub must visibly identify that Project Direction has not been normalized yet.

strategy.problem: Reduce the research burden and uncertainty involved in deciding which inventory an eBay seller should investigate before spending money.
strategy.customer: Active eBay sellers sourcing new inventory.
strategy.whyNow: SourceMargin already has a working research workflow and a canonical research console. The immediate prerequisite is a launch-ready product/app; after that, the largest unresolved question is commercial validation.
strategy.northStar: Help sellers find products with demonstrated demand, viable sources and understandable economics before buying inventory.
strategy.businessModel: Low-friction sourcing report or starter offer → app subscription → higher-value seller intelligence.
strategy.longTermDestination: A commerce-intelligence platform with a proprietary graph of products, sellers, suppliers, demand, economics and observed outcomes.

decision.decisionBeingEarned: Will active eBay sellers repeatedly pay for validated sourcing intelligence and use it to make real sourcing decisions?
decision.currentHypothesis: If SourceMargin combines demand evidence, viable supplier options and understandable economics in one workflow, active sellers will use it to reduce sourcing uncertainty and will pay repeatedly for fresh opportunities.
decision.nextGate: Reach launch-ready product/app state, then recruit and serve the first 10 paying pilot customers.
successCriteria: First 10 paying pilot customers complete real use of the product.
Reach 25 paying customers as the initial commercial proof gate.
At least 40% of paying customers return weekly during the proof period.
At least 5 customers take a real sourcing action from a SourceMargin opportunity.
Validated opportunities can be produced at sustainable unit economics.
killCriteria: Repeated paid-user evidence shows the intelligence does not materially change sourcing decisions.
Validated opportunities cannot be replenished at sustainable unit economics after reasonable process and automation improvements.
Supplier/product equivalence cannot be made reliable enough to support customer trust.

nextActions: Prepare the launch dataset, onboarding flow and low-friction starter offer.
Recruit the first 10 paying pilot customers and instrument the sourcing-action funnel.
blockers: Paid pilot should not begin until the product/app is launch-ready.

evidence.confidenceNote: Research capability is established, but willingness-to-pay and repeat usage remain unproven until the paid pilot.
proven: Seller catalog mining is already part of the SourceMargin research workflow.
Demand validation and supplier-candidate research are already represented in the project workflow.
A canonical SourceMargin research console is deployed and registered in Factory Control.
unproven: Active sellers will pay repeatedly for the intelligence.
High-quality opportunities can be replenished cheaply enough for attractive SaaS economics.
Supplier equivalence and economics can scale with enough reliability for broad customer use.
evidence.latestResult: SourceMargin research console auto-deploy pipeline was verified on 2026-09-16.

history.decision: Adopt paid-validation launch sequencing and canonical Project Direction tracking for SourceMargin.
history.previousState: Product and research execution existed without a standardized strategic state layer on the Hub card.
history.newState: Build → paid pilot → prove → scale, with explicit evidence and kill gates.
history.reason: Once the product/app is launch-ready, commercial willingness-to-pay is the next major decision to earn.
